mathematical_checks: One O-centered physical grid with common box and union of all radial knots yields a common Hilbert embedding.
Radial GL p+1 integrates u products of degree 2p; eta GL lmax+1 integrates same-m angular products through degree 2lmax; uniform phi >=2*mmax+1 eliminates distinct-m overlaps.
For E†WE=M, H_emb=E M^-1 H M^-1 E†W is W-selfadjoint and C†HC is the projected finite weak-form operator.
Conjugate exp(+/-i phi) partners are admissible only under the registered real spinless static axial Hamiltonian.
conditions_before_launch: Exact resolved radial knots, all task IDs, input/source hashes, exact backend/layout set and global repeated-work budgets must be pinned.
Campaign-level wall and memory accounting must specify whether limits are per layout and give a total cap.
5e-3 energy / 0.05 projector refinement criteria are exploratory finite-basis diagnostics, not true-error bounds.
Nonnested meshes prohibit interpreting successive Ritz changes as monotone variational convergence.
Observed guard floor is not a full-spectrum external-gap lower bound, especially with omitted |m|>=2 sectors.
All failures and incomplete pilot state must be preserved; qualification failure must not trigger unregistered automatic enlargement.
